cli: codex-cli 0.149.0 (host freeze must verify exact output before preflight)
prompt_serialization: frozen system prompt, two LF bytes, exact materialized context
session_isolation: --ephemeral; one fresh Codex invocation and one fresh full pinned worktree per run

worktree_architecture.checkout: shallow pinned local source mirror checkout with complete tree

normalized_test_contract.unknown_or_unparseable_policy: row is INVALID and V5 stops; no repair-and-resume

status_capture: git status --porcelain=v1 before and after the model run

network.coding_agent_provider: inherits the normal host shell network environment
network.provider_precheck: DNS and TCP reachability to chatgpt.com:443 before preflight and before every statistical batch
network.dependency_setup: pinned source and shared dependency caches are prepared before model calls; task commands use frozen offline policy

storage.shared_caches: immutable source/dependency caches shared across arms; no source modifications or result data
storage.per_slot_outputs: full worktree, temporary files, Go build cache, and Cargo target removed in lifecycle finally

retry_policy: retry only objective infrastructure failures with no usable model output; never retry a usable coding result
statistical_design: 7 tasks x 3 arms x 3 repetitions = 63 fresh V5 Codex runs
